subject: City Charter Review Listening Session
overview: The Charter Study Committee held a public informational and listening session to outline the city charter review process and receive community feedback on potential municipal government reforms. No formal votes or actions were taken.

items.title: Presentation on Charter Review and Municipal Government Options
items.summary: Committee members presented an overview of Medford's current Plan A charter and outlined potential reform areas, including mayoral versus city manager forms of government, council composition, and term lengths.

items.title: Committee Member Backgrounds and Appointment Process
items.summary: In response to resident questions concerning the committee's formation and qualifications, members explained the municipal appointment process and introduced their personal and professional backgrounds.

items.title: Public Listening Session on Governance and Outreach
items.summary: Residents and participants offered suggestions regarding public engagement strategies, balancing executive and council authority, budget oversight, and establishing periodic charter reviews.

items.title: Outreach Plans and Discussion on Ward Representation
items.summary: The committee shared upcoming meeting dates and community outreach plans, followed by public and member discussion regarding ward-based representation, council size, and ranked-choice voting.
